title: Karen G Mother NDE 5304
content: My dad was in Korea. He was an engineer in the military and they were there planning some reconstruction projects. I was a baby, approximately 8-9 months old. My mother was having chronic problems after giving birth through a C-Section and the doctors brought her in to have a hysterectomy. My dad was overseas, as I said. She said she remembered going to sleep on the table and then she was suddenly looking down from the ceiling at her body. She saw people running around acting like they were trying to revive her. She was calmly watching, though a little confused why they were doing it. She felt detached from her body and totally at peace. My mother said everything seemed to start getting further and further away as she went up and up towards the ceiling. It got fuzzy as she seemed to be passing through the ceiling and she could look up at a light. But it wasn't a LIGHT. It was like an openness; an awakening that her brain registered as a light. She said it felt it was like going home and she felt really good. But then she started to panic. My dad was in Korea and she was worried about who would take care of me on earth. The next thing she knew, she was slammed back into her body. She used the words 'SLAMMED' and 'out-of-body experience' and 'light' very clearly every time she told me the story. She said the doctors said that she was flat lined for 4 minutes. She told her experience to a nurse. At this time, she had never ever heard anyone recite a story like this in any fashion in the media or anywhere else. She thought her experience was completely unique. The nurse responded by saying she has heard stories just like that from many people. I feel like sharing this is important since you are collecting experiences

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Detached from her body; 'totally at peace' and calmly watching (though confused).

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Everything getting further and further away as she went up and up toward/through the ceiling; it got fuzzy as she seemed to be passing through the ceiling.

environment.environment_other_detail: The 'light' was described as not a LIGHT but like an openness/awakening her brain registered as a light.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: She said she was 'slammed back into her body.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Hysterectomy after chronic problems following C-section.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Upward movement and passing through the ceiling into 'openness/awakening' registered as light; panic about child led to return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE from ceiling, then upward movement through/into ceiling with 'light/openness', then panic and sudden return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The 'light' was described as not literally a light but an 'openness; an awakening that her brain registered as a light.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “SLAMMED” (back into her body); “flat lined for 4 minutes”; “It was like an openness; an awakening that her brain registered as a light.”; “like going home.”
